entries.title: John 17:1
segments: After saying this, Jesus raised his eyes heaven-wards, and said: "Father, the hour has come; honor thy Son, that thy Son may honor thee;

entries.title: John 17:2
segments: Even as thou gavest him power over all mankind, that he should give Immortal Life to all those whom thou has given him.

entries.title: John 17:3
segments: And the Immortal Life is this--to know thee the one true God, and Jesus Christ whom thou has sent as thy Messenger.

entries.title: John 17:4
segments: I have honored thee on earth by completing the work which thou has given me to do;

entries.title: John 17:5
segments: And now do thou honor me, Father, at thy own side, with the honor which I had at thy side before the world began.

entries.title: John 17:6
segments: I have revealed thee to those whom thou gavest me from the world; they were thy own, and thou gavest them to me; and they have laid thy Message to heart.

entries.title: John 17:7
segments: They recognize now that everything that thou gavest me was from thee;

entries.title: John 17:8
segments: For I have given them the teaching which thou gavest me, and they received it, and clearly understood that I came from thee, and they believed that thou has sent me as thy Messenger.

entries.title: John 17:9
segments: I intercede for them; I am not interceding for the world, but for those whom thou has given me, for they are thy own--

entries.title: John 17:10
segments: All that is mine is thine, and all that is thine is mine-- and I am honored in them.

entries.title: John 17:11
segments: Now I am to be in this world no longer, but they are still to be in the world, and I am to come to thee. Holy Father, keep them by that revelation of thy Name which thou has given me, that they may be one, as we are.

entries.title: John 17:12
segments: Whilst I was with them, I kept them by that revelation, and I have guarded them; and not one of them has been lost, except that lost soul--in fulfillment of Scripture.

entries.title: John 17:13
segments: But now I am to come to thee; and I am speaking thus, while still in the world, that they may have my own joy, in all its fullness, in their hearts.

entries.title: John 17:14
segments: I have given them thy Message; and the world hated them, because they do not belong to the world, even as I do not belong to the world.

entries.title: John 17:15
segments: I do not ask thee to take them out of the world, but to keep them from Evil.

entries.title: John 17:16
segments: They do not belong to the world, even as I do not belong to the world.

entries.title: John 17:17
segments: Consecrate them by the Truth; thy Message is Truth.

entries.title: John 17:18
segments: Just as thou has sent me as thy Messenger to the world, so I send them as my Messengers to the world.

entries.title: John 17:19
segments: And it is for their sakes that I am consecrating myself, so that they also may be truly consecrated.

entries.title: John 17:20
segments: But it is not only for them that I am interceding, but also for those who believe in me through their Message,

entries.title: John 17:21
segments: That they all may be one--that as thou, Father, art in union with us--and so the world may believe that thou hast sent me as thy Messenger.

entries.title: John 17:22
segments: I have given them the honor which thou has given me, that they may be one as we are one--

entries.title: John 17:23
segments: I in union with them and thou with me--that so they may be perfected in their union, and thus the world may know that thou hast sent me as thy Messenger, and that thou has loved them as thou hast loved me.

entries.title: John 17:24
segments: Father, my desire for all those whom thou has given me is that they may be with me where I am, so that they may see the honor which thou has given me; for thou didst love me before the beginning of the world.

entries.title: John 17:25
segments: O righteous Father, though the world did not know thee, I knew thee; and these men knew that thou has sent me as thy Messenger.

entries.title: John 17:26
segments: I have made thee known to them, and will do so still; that the love that thou has had for me may be in their hearts, and that I may be in them also."
